question: What foundation depth is required for the sign posts drawn in Figure 2A-2?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The MUTCD does not specify a required foundation depth for the sign posts shown in Figure 2A-2. The figure illustrates mounting heights (e.g., 5 ft or 7 ft minimum to the bottom of the sign) and lateral offsets (e.g., 6 ft or 12 ft minimum), not foundation depths. The only related requirement is a general performance standard that posts, foundations, and mountings must hold signs securely in place; no numeric depth is prescribed in the evidence provided. Standards (mandatory): - "Sign posts, foundations, and mountings shall be so constructed as to hold signs in a proper and permanent position, and to resist swaying in the wind or displacement by vandalism." (This is a performance requirement, not a dimensional foundation-depth requirement.) Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 2A-2 (p.51) shows the buried portions of sign posts below the ground line but includes no dimension or annotation for foundation/embedment depth; all labeled dimensions (5 ft MIN., 7 ft MIN., 12 ft MIN., 6 ft MIN., 17 ft MIN., 8 ft MIN., etc.) pertain to sign height and lateral offset. - [Image 4] Page 92 (Figure 2A-2 duplicate view) likewise depicts post embedment schematically with hatching but provides no foundation depth dimension. - [Image 3] Page 89 (Figure 2A-1) shows a "2 ft MAX." dimension, but it applies to the height of a retroreflective strip termination above the ground on a sign support, not to foundation depth. - [Image 2] Page 566 and [Image 5] Page 831 show mounting heights and lateral offsets for recreational-area and temporary traffic control signs, respectively, with no foundation depth information. Citations: - Section 2A.18 Standard §1 (p.60) - Section 2A.13 Support §1 (p.50) - Figure 2A-2 (p.51)
gold_answer: The MUTCD does not specify this information. A correct response should state that the requested value or requirement cannot be determined from the manual rather than inventing an answer.
